heading: Thursday Night
text: Chance of rain or snow showers near and north of Route 2. Rain or snow likely elsewhere, changing to mostly snow. A trace to an inch in the valleys, 2 to 4 inches in the Adirondacks and southern Greens. Lows from the upper 20s to mid 30s. North to northeast winds 5 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday
text: Mostly cloudy. Chance early snow showers near and north of Route 2; otherwise early snow, steadiest south of Route 4, all tapering off while changing to rain in the valleys. Additional snow a trace to an inch, mainly over high terrain south. Valley highs in the upper 30s to lower 40s. North winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 20 mph in the Champlain Valley.

heading: Friday Night
text: Cloudy. Scattered late-night snow showers in the northern mountains. Lows from the mid 20s to lower 30s. North winds 5 to 10 mph, gusting to 15 mph in the Champlain Valley.
